Trekking with Pang in Sa Pa
Mar 2024 • Family
My wife and I had an amazing day of trekking in Sa Pa with our guide Pang (What’s App# 84 33 594 7402). She met us at our hotel and we walked through a beautiful part of Sa Pa en route to our trail , which took us up into the mountains where we were treated to stunning views of the mountains and Sa Pa. There were clouds and some fog , which only made the views more magical. Pang was knowledgeable, humorous and so friendly. Her English is outstanding. We were treated to a fabulous lunch ( do not miss the mango smoothie), after which we descended the mountain on a very scenic trail. The hike was about 9 miles with some moderately steep sections, but the pace was perfect ( you determine the pace). I would highly recommend this experience and Pang specifically, it was perhaps the highlight of our trip to Vietnam.

Nature View Hotel
Dear Allison,
Thank you very much for taking the time to share such a wonderful review of your experience in Sa Pa. We are delighted to hear that you and your wife had an amazing trekking day and were able to enjoy the beautiful landscapes, mountain views, and the magical atmosphere of Sa Pa.
It’s great to know that the experience, the scenery, and the lunch during your journey made your trip memorable. Sa Pa truly offers unique natural beauty, and we are always happy when our guests can fully enjoy it.
Thank you again for your kind recommendation and for visiting Sa Pa. We hope to have the pleasure of welcoming you back to this beautiful region in the future.
Warm regards,
SaPa Nature View Team

Repeated visit to Sapa Natureview Restaurant (before and after covid ) years: 2019,2023
Mar 2023 • Family
Sapa Natureview restaurant is a nice place to dine at. It is a place that my family and I revisited during our stays at Sapa (Pre- COVID and post COVID). The view was definitely amazing and the food was tasty and reasonably priced. Some of the dishes that really stand out were the bún chả and nem cuốn chiên (fried spring rolls). The ingredients were fresh and had a robust flavour. In addition to the good food and scenic views , the staff were really friendly. Therefore It is a place that is really worth visiting.

Reviewed by Joseph (Singapore)

A delightful surprise
Jan 2020 • Couples
We have to agree with previous reviews about the hostess Ahn....amazing service above and beyond expectations.
We went twice because she was so helpful and the food was of a high standard for the price - great value.
We tried a couple of the soups, veg curry, venison, and even some local foods not on the menu...all really good!
Ahn was kind enough to organize a tour for us with her local knowledge and contacts, even though we were staying at another hotel.
Try their fruit infused local rice wine and enjoy the open fire place, views are awesome during the day, and the rooftop is a great place to relax for drinks or lunch. Highly recommended. 👍🏻👍🏻👍🏻
